name: duopore-public-interview-star-outline
description: Turn a real work example into a clear interview answer using the STAR format.

interface.longDescription: Turn a real work example into a clear interview answer using the STAR format. Add the situation, your task, the actions you took and the result. Get these four parts in order, with your source references and a rough speaking time. For adults using their own experience. It keeps your facts and does not invent results or guarantee an interview outcome.
defaultPrompt: Help me structure this real work example as a STAR answer.
Estimate how long this interview answer may take to say.

review.commerce_description: Free useful computation. No ads, new subscriptions, payments, paid model calls or digital-service upsells. Separate commercial hypotheses are internal planning only.

publication.release_notes: Clear benefit-first descriptions and original bold geometric branding with light/dark icon variants. App behavior, privacy, connections and review evidence unchanged.
